name: orea-ai-image-enhancer
description: Restore and transform user-provided photos with AI from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Bring new clarity to old, pixelated, blurry, or worn photos and create polished AI portraits with Orea, directly in ChatGPT and Codex. Open the visual editor, upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP you own or have permission to edit, then choose one of five portrait-focused presets: Enhance, Grayscale, Muscle, Clay, or Professional Headshot.

Use Enhance to sharpen details, improve clarity, and refresh low-quality portraits, selfies, group pictures, scanned family photos, and vintage camera images. Orea can also create timeless black-and-white edits, athletic portrait transformations, handcrafted clay-style portraits, and studio-ready professional headshots.

Orea works from your uploaded image rather than searching the web or generating an unrelated image from scratch. Results may vary, especially with heavily damaged source photos, so review each result before use.
defaultPrompt: Enhance a portrait while keeping the person recognizable.
Turn my photo into a professional headshot.
Show me my recent Orea edits.

positive.description: Open the Orea editor for a general AI portrait enhancement request and complete an edit with a reviewer-owned image.
positive.prompt: Enhance my portrait and keep me recognizable.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Orea editor beside the conversation. After the reviewer selects Enhance and uploads an allowed image, privately upload it, start one generation, show progress, then show the completed before-and-after result. If generation fails, show the failure and refund the credit.

positive.description: Open the Orea editor when the user asks to turn their own picture into a professional headshot.
positive.prompt: Turn my photo into a polished professional headshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the editor with Professional Headshot available. After the reviewer selects that preset and uploads an allowed portrait, create the edit while preserving recognizable identity and display the private result.

positive.description: Open the Orea editor for a black-and-white edit of a user-provided portrait.
positive.prompt: Make my portrait black and white.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the editor with Grayscale available. After the reviewer uploads an allowed portrait and confirms generation, produce a grayscale result and show it in the editor.

positive.description: List the currently available Orea presets without requiring an upload or spending a credit.
positive.prompt: What kinds of AI photo edits can Orea do right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Return Enhance, Grayscale, Muscle, Clay, and Professional Headshot with their descriptions and one-credit costs. Do not create an upload or generation.

positive.description: Show only the connected review account's recent Orea edits.
positive.prompt: Show me my recent Orea edits.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recent generations belonging only to the connected account, including status and short-lived private image links when available. Do not expose another user's records.

negative.description: Orea should not run for unrestricted text-to-image generation because it edits only a user-provided picture. ChatGPT should answer normally or suggest an appropriate image-generation workflow instead.
negative.prompt: Generate a brand-new image of a beach at sunset from scratch.

negative.description: Orea should not search the web for a person's image or edit a photo the user has not supplied and confirmed they may edit. ChatGPT should decline the Orea action and ask for a permitted user-provided image if appropriate.
negative.prompt: Find a photo of a celebrity online and use Orea to make them more muscular.

negative.description: Orea should not open for text-only photography advice. ChatGPT should answer the camera-settings question directly without invoking an Orea tool.
negative.prompt: What camera settings should I use for an indoor portrait?

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.2 submission package for Orea, retaining the existing listing, MCP connection, five positive and three negative review test cases, walkthrough video, and icon.
